summary: AIM ImmunoTech filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 2,554,119 shares at $0.5189/share, concurrently with a private placement of unregistered shares, pre-funded warrants, and common warrants. The offering is underwritten by Ladenburg Thalmann on a best-efforts basis with no escrow or minimum. The filing is a routine capital raise under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change. The company is simply selling securities to raise funds.
